{{recipesummary|servings=8|time=Prep: 10 minutes
Chilling: until frozen/cold|difficulty=1|image=[[Image:Brandy butter.jpg|300px]] }}{{recipe}} ==Ingredients== * 75 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] [[Cookbook:Butter|unsalted butter]] * 75 g sieved [[Cookbook:Powdered Sugar|icing sugar]] or [[Cookbook:Caster sugar|caster sugar]] * 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Brandy|brandy]] ==Procedure== # [[Cookbook:Creaming|Cream]] together the butter and sugar until light and fluffy. # Gradually [[Cookbook:Beat|beat]] in the brandy. # Chill before serving. # Serve with Christmas pudding and warm mince pies. ==Notes and variations== * Brandy butter can be kept for several weeks if made with fresh butter and stored covered in the fridge. * Brandy butter is a 'hard sauce', meaning it contains alcohol. Other, rather similar hard sauces can be made by substituting the brandy with rum, whiskey, or sherry. * Some people like to add a few more ingredients. Here is a list of some of the options you could try: ** A dash of [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla]] extract ** [[Cookbook:Orange|Orange]] or [[Cookbook:Lemon|lemon]] zest ** Spices such as [[Cookbook:Nutmeg|nutmeg]], [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|cinnamon]], or [[Cookbook:Allspice|allspice]] **a small handful of flaked nuts [[Category:Christmas recipes]] [[Category:Recipes for dessert]] [[Category:Recipes using brandy]] [[Category:Recipes with metric units]] [[Category:Recipes for sauces and condiments]] [[Category:Recipes using butter]] [[Category:Recipes using powdered sugar]] [[Category:Recipes using superfine sugar]]
